build.energy_regen_target: around 125% (Game8's recommended starting point; tune per team)
build.fast_path: Fast path: Tragicomedy + 5-piece Midnight Veil in a 4-3-3-1-1 layout with Nightmare: Impermanence Heron in the main slot. Run a CRIT 4-cost, double Havoc DMG 3-costs (swap one to Energy Regen if her Liberation is not ready each rotation), ATK% 1-costs, and aim for around 125% Energy Regen with 70% Crit Rate to maximize her Liberation's team ATK buff.
